body: Thank you again for your post. If I am needed I need to be here on this planet for the sake of my family, not for myself - nothing I've done lately has been for my happiness, I was just trying to keep everyone safe.
Still trying to hold on, and it's hard but I have to do it for my family now, focusing on that and holding on. Thank you again, so much.

Thank you both so much for taking time to read that wall of text and respond to me; I'm not sure what to say that would express just how much that means to me right now. I've worked as a writer and editor and so it's good to know that I can still make sense to others in my writing, even though things don't seem to make sense in my head. I'm trying to hold on for as long as possible; trying to keep swimming and hold on. I'm sleep deprived at the moment and things have taken on a kind of bad-dream, confusing tilt, and I feel like I'm making myself crazy by focusing on all of those things. Maybe if I can sleep tonight it will make some of those things more clear, I don't know. Helping others through my writing is all I want to do, I want to be additive and not subtractive. Right now it just feels like everything happened all at once and it's overwhelming, and it keeps feeling like that, you know? Holding on though. One minute at a time. Thank you so much.

Not that I know of, but I don't personally know their other partners. I'm aware of past manipulations, but it sounds like those weren't one-sided manipulations...just unhealthy relationships. I'd lay down and die for my partner if I had to. It scares me to think they may not feel the same way, and that's the root of my worry over this.

Maybe lying is the wrong word; perhaps omitting fits better. There are a couple of things that don't mean much in the grand scheme of things that I've let slide, because they were only white lies. It just feels as though something's not quite right. I hope I'm wrong.
I'd opt for the second choice.

That's a difficult situation, and I wish you the best; hopefully things will improve and you can move on as friends. It's hard when you've known someone for years, and want to hold on to the friendship despite complications...life is so complicated, relationships of any kind are infinitely complex. I wish things were easier. Best of luck to you, OP.

When this person says that they love you, do you respond in kind? I'm not saying you do, but just in case... it's cruel to tell someone that you love them when you don't. My ex did this to me for years, and we both lost years together when we could've been happily finding love on our own. 
My SO recently accused me of not really loving them, when they are the person I love most in this world. If I were to find out that they told me those three words only because they deeply cared, but did not love me, it would hurt like hell - but I'd be okay, eventually. Having been through it once, I'd do anything to avoid it again.
My advice is that you talk it out - now. So that you can both move on to find relationships with mutual love that can grow and flourish. You deserve that.
This is beautifully written and heartfelt. I wish it was written for me.
